question: Which of the following is not a Cricketer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saina Nehwal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saina Nehwal is a badminton player, not a cricketer.**
 
• She is a **former world number 1 and has won several major titles, including the Olympic bronze**** medal in 2012.**
 
• The other three options, **Sachin Tendulkar, Javagal Srinath, and Rahul Dravid, are all former Indian cricketers.**
 
• Tendulkar is considered to be one of the** greatest batsmen of all time**, while** Srinath was one of the fastest bowlers in the world.**
 
• **Dravid was a renowned batsman who was known for his solid defence and his ability to score runs in all conditions.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sachin Tendulkar** is widely regarded as one of the** greatest batsmen of all time.**

 
 
• He holds the record for the most runs scored in Test and ODI cricket, **and he is also the only batsman to have scored 100 centuries in international cricket.**
 
 
 
• **Javagal Srinath** was** one of the fastest bowlers in the world during his playing career**.
 
 
• He is the** second-highest wicket-taker for India in Test cricket,** and he is also the **only Indian bowler to have taken** **200 wickets in ODI cricket.**
 
 
 
• **Rahul Dravid **was a renowned batsman who was known for his solid defence and his ability to score runs in all conditions.
 
 
• He is the **fourth-highest run-scorer for India in Test cricket, **and he is also the only **Indian batsman to have scored 10,000 runs in both Test and ODI cricket.**
